race.comment: MR SIOUX (5) is the one with upside having been backed off the map and doing enough to win his maiden at Warrnambool last start, sent out $1.45 and winning by half a length. The runner-up there has since won easily so the form looks stronger than on first glance and he's expected to improve again. FARSIDE (9) is off a Bendigo maiden win and has claims with further improvement, he can roll forward from the gate and give a sight. OVERPRICED (7) was solid here last time when third and maps for every chance from the soft gate. ROCK THEM JOOLS (3) resumes, his best form reads well for this although he usually takes a run. He can prove hard to hold out.
